# Destroyed tank repair

Used in [Engineering](/rules/80-engineering).

## Table

| Die | Field | Axis facility german | Axis facility italian | Axis facility commonwealth | CW facility |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | repaired | repaired | repaired | repaired | repaired |
| 2 | — | repaired | repaired | repaired | repaired |
| 3 | — | repaired | — | — | — |
| 4 | — | — | — | — | — |
| 5 | — | — | junked | — | — |
| 6–7 | — | junked | junked | junked | junked |

## Notes

- One die per destroyed-tank point attempt; add one at a minor repair facility (chart note, SPI 22.4x). Field = repair in the field, only by a Tank Delivery Squadron (Commonwealth) or the Mobile Tank Recovery Squadron (German). Axis facility columns are by the tank's nationality (German, Italian, captured Commonwealth); a Commonwealth facility treats all nationalities alike
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 102) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p8): 0 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
